technical_and_design_decisions: Target Java 17+ with a Spring Framework 6 / Spring Boot 3.x baseline, consistent with the Spring Framework 6.0 requirement stated in the specification.

For U6, introduce a centralized parameter-handling/escaping abstraction in the Sqoop job module so users supply raw GPDB parameter values and all shell-level quoting/escaping is handled internally.
Use Git with feature branches and a pull-request workflow; every activity is gated by CI verification before merge.

activities.activity_description: Complete the outstanding implementation of the DEBS challenge solution (event processing queries, data ingestion wiring, and result output) building on the partially existing work.

activities.activity_description: Run functional tests against challenge data sets, validate correctness of results, fix defects, and package the solution for submission by the deadline.

activities.activity_description: Add a new CI build configuration that checks out the project and executes the Gradle install target, including build triggers, artifact archiving, and test report publication.

activities.activity_name: U2 - Stabilize CI build and resolve install target issues
activities.activity_description: Run the new CI build repeatedly, diagnose and fix environment- or build-related failures so the install target expectations are verified reliably in CI.

activities.activity_description: Develop the XD + Kafka POC: stream/job definitions integrating Kafka source/sink modules, any minimal custom module code needed, and local verification against a Kafka cluster.

activities.activity_description: Write the README with setup and execution instructions, clean up the code, and publish the POC to the samples repository for use as reference architecture in the XD blog.

activities.activity_name: U4 - Execute jdbchdfs performance benchmark runs
activities.activity_description: Set up the benchmark environment (HDFS and database), execute the jdbchdfs performance benchmark suite with the new improvements, and collect raw measurements.

activities.activity_description: Analyze benchmark results, compare against baseline figures, verify that the jdbchdfs optimizations deliver the expected gains, and document findings.

activities.activity_description: Write JMH-based benchmark cases around TupleBuilder covering representative tuple shapes, sizes, and usage patterns to enable bottleneck identification.

activities.activity_name: U5 - Run TupleBuilder benchmarks, identify bottlenecks, and tune
activities.activity_description: Execute the benchmark suite, profile hot spots, apply targeted performance tuning changes to TupleBuilder, and re-run benchmarks to confirm improvements.

activities.activity_description: Implement centralized parameter handling in the Sqoop job module so GPDB parameters no longer require manual escaping by the user, including unit tests for the new escaping logic.

activities.activity_description: Execute the Sqoop job end-to-end against SQL Server and GPDB instances, compare the parameter UX between the two targets, and document the differences and validation results.

activities.activity_name: U7 - Design pluggable module deployment runtime SPI
activities.activity_description: Define the ModuleDeployer SPI contract, discovery mechanism, lifecycle semantics, and the migration/adaptation strategy away from the repository abstraction used for stream/job definitions.

activities.activity_name: U7 - Implement SPI and migrate module deployment off the repository abstraction
activities.activity_description: Implement the SPI interfaces and default implementations, refactor existing module deployment code behind the new SPI, provide a backward-compatibility adapter, and deprecate the old repository-based path.

activities.activity_name: U7 - Test migrated module deployment
activities.activity_description: Write and execute unit and integration tests covering module deployment through the new SPI, including stream and job deployment scenarios and backward-compatibility behavior.

activities.activity_name: U8 - Implement isolated Boot-based ModuleRunner
activities.activity_description: Build the standalone Spring Boot based ModuleRunner that loads and runs XD modules without requiring xd-containers, including configuration, module classpath isolation, and lifecycle management.

activities.activity_name: U8 - Integration-test ModuleRunner in a container-managed environment
activities.activity_description: Deploy and integration-test the ModuleRunner in a container-managed environment, verify module execution, configuration injection, logging, and restart behavior end-to-end.

activities.activity_name: Increment-wide integration and regression testing
activities.activity_description: Run the full build and regression test suites across all affected modules, verify interactions between the changes (SPI migration, ModuleRunner, parameter handling), and fix integration defects.

activities.activity_name: Documentation updates and release preparation
activities.activity_description: Update reference documentation and wiki pages for the new SPI, ModuleRunner, GPDB parameter UX, CI build, and samples; prepare release notes and finalize the increment for delivery.
